home.heading: Erlangen Cricket Club
home.intro: Seven-time champions and five-time T20 Regionalliga runners-up, playing cricket in Erlangen since 2010. Everyone who loves the game is welcome.

statement.heading: Our titles
statement.text: Seven titles since 2010. Bavarian champions in 2012. Indoor and one-day champions in 2014 and 2015. Bundesliga champions in 2017 and 2023. T20 Regionalliga runners-up five times, most recently in 2025 and 2026. Today two teams play in four competitions, and there is room for you.
